description: Cuts output tokens 65.6-74.7% depending on level (standard/max), measured on a 5-prompt live-model eval rather than estimated. Every sentence stays complete and grammatical at every level — never fragments like caveman-style compression. Use when the user says "introvert mode", "quiet mode", "talk less", "be minimal", "less words", "stop rambling", "fewer tokens", or invokes /introvert. A one-off "be brief" is not a trigger.
